description: This Python source file generates documentation for supported pandas APIs in PySpark, including functions to check pandas version, collect support status, and write RST formatted documentation tables.

classes.name: SupportedStatus
classes.description: Defines the support status for specific pandas APIs, indicating whether they are implemented, not implemented, or partially implemented, along with missing parameters.

classes.name: Implemented
classes.description: Enumeration of implementation statuses: 'Y' for implemented, 'N' for not implemented, 'P' for partially implemented.

methods.name: generate_supported_api
methods.description: Main function to generate the supported pandas API documentation in RST format, writing to specified file path.

methods.name: _check_pandas_version
methods.description: Checks if the installed pandas version matches the expected latest version, raising an error if not.

methods.name: _collect_supported_status
methods.description: Collects support status information across pandas and pyspark.pandas modules.

methods.name: _get_pd_modules
methods.description: Retrieves sorted list of pandas module member names, excluding private members.

methods.name: _update_all_supported_status
methods.description: Updates the overall support status dictionary with data from each module group.

methods.name: _create_supported_by_module
methods.description: Creates support status dictionary for a specific pandas module, comparing pandas and pyspark.pandas functions.

methods.name: _organize_by_implementation_status
methods.description: Determines implementation status for each function, marking as fully implemented, partially, or not implemented.

methods.name: _transform_missing
methods.description: Formats missing parameters into a string for documentation, adding links if missing parameters exceed a threshold.

methods.name: _write_table
methods.description: Writes a support status table in RST format for a module's functions.

methods.name: _escape_func_str
methods.description: Escapes function names for RST formatting, handling trailing underscores.

methods.name: _write_rst
methods.description: Writes the complete RST documentation file with support status tables for all modules.

methods.name: _test
methods.description: Runs doctest to verify the module's functionality.
